name: specnaut-marketplace
description: Specnaut: spec-driven planning, implementation, review and delivery for coding agents.

plugins.name: specnaut-plugin
plugins.description: Specnaut's auto-chained spec-driven workflow, slash commands, and sub-agents for Claude Code — the same content the binary scaffolds, available as a versioned plugin.

plugins.name: specnaut-cockpit
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: it runs a hooks module inside Claude Code with your permissions. Shows usage limits, context, cost and the Specnaut chain above the prompt, and refuses one call: the step that would start implement, review or merge past the quota threshold.
